body.text: All updates below are for Clash Arena.

texts: Added Team Bonuses mechanic. If enabled, rounds can now randomly generate Faction or Keyword bonuses. If a bonus is active, skills owned by an identity who shares factions or keywords with other identities drafted by the same player will get bonuses.

Added Blacklist phases. If enabled, a Blacklist phase is inserted between every 2 cycles of drafting identities. Players get to choose identities to blacklist, preventing other players from drafting them.
Added the SP bias setting. Changing this setting will bias the random SP generation to prefer lower or higher sp values within the specified range.
Added the option to open rooms to public. Public rooms are visible on the room joining page, so anyone can easily join.
Added an option to set an alert sound during drafting. The alert plays when it's the player's turn to draft or a blacklist phase starts.
Recomputed the point values of E.G.O. The previous point values had an issue in their computation.
Made some layout changes to the setup screen.
Made some changes to the server to hopefully reduce crashes and make diagnosing future issues easier.
Fixed an issue where using Si Branch Gregor's S3 could crash the Clash Arena room under certain conditions.
Added some missing text to Brand Manager Don.
